text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 8: CAMS's implied capacity swings the most with the seasons'

g.text: Figure 8: CAMS's implied capacity swings the most with the seasons

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Implied capacity: metered output over what a fixed south-facing panel at 30° tilt predicts per megawatt from the product. Each point: the mean over generators and years of that calendar month's log implied capacity minus the generator's own mean, shown as a percentage. Zero is the annual mean. Unconstrained hours with the sun above 10°. No interval is drawn. With the seasonal cycle removed, CAMS's month-to-month spread is the smallest: 6.5%, against 7.9% to 10.0%. 6 solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to September 2026.'
text.tspan: Implied capacity: metered output over what a fixed south-facing panel at 30° tilt predicts per megawatt from the product.
Each point: the mean over generators and years of that calendar month's log implied capacity minus the generator's own mean,
shown as a percentage. Zero is the annual mean. Unconstrained hours with the sun above 10°. No interval is drawn.
With the seasonal cycle removed, CAMS's month-to-month spread is the smallest: 6.5%, against 7.9% to 10.0%.
6 solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to September 2026.
